invariants: Never wire or import the merge seam (the queue drain or any live lane-merge path).
Never compute live SHAs for static fixtures — only allowed for runtime git reads explicitly carved out in design D-E.
Never self-certify — the auditor identity in the proof bundle must differ from the implementer; operator verifies before orchestrator advance.
Never bind ConPort, dope-memory, or task-orchestrator endpoints — no live service calls.
Never promote external corroboration (DR-015, DR-016) to repo authority — cite provenance tags as EXTERNAL_PROPOSED or REPO_VALIDATED.
LIVE_WRITE_READY remains undefined and blocking — classifier blocked-posture on any PROVISIONAL class that lacks an approval_policy.yaml entry.
Delete-list execution (removing dead/deprecated commands) is explicitly DX-overhaul scope — this TP only adds the metadata substrate; do not delete any commands or skills.
The CI gate must reject additions of unlabeled commands/skills — enforcement_side must be present and non-empty; owner must be present.
Harness auto-discovery of .claude/commands/ is preserved — this manifest is governance metadata only, not a replacement for discovery.

commit.message: feat(dcp): governance-metadata manifest for commands/skills, CI unlabeled-addition gate

pr.title: feat(dcp): commands/skills governance-metadata manifest + CI gate (DMX-DCP-TOOLING-115)
pr.body:
## Summary
- Adds schemas/dcp/commands_registry.schema.json: validates entries with required fields name, surface, enforcement_side (deterministic|llm_advisory|human), mutation_class, owner.
- Creates config/dcp/commands_registry.json: initial governance-metadata entries for .claude/commands/ and skills. Entries for all existing commands are seeded with enforcement_side=llm_advisory where applicable per the ADR (A.3).
- CI gate: validates every .claude/commands/*.md file has a corresponding entry in commands_registry.json with all required fields; unlabeled additions fail CI.
- Harness auto-discovery of .claude/commands/ is preserved — the manifest is additive governance metadata, not a discovery replacement.
- Delete-list execution remains explicitly DX-overhaul scope — no commands or skills are deleted.

## Validation
- Schema validates instance.
- CI gate rejects a missing entry.
- CI gate rejects an entry with enforcement_side absent.
- All existing commands have registry entries.

## NOT_RUN
- Delete-list execution (DX-overhaul scope, out of scope here).
- Runtime enforcement of enforcement_side declarations (V2).

steps.task: Preflight: enumerate .claude/commands/ to count existing commands and identify surface types. Confirm TP-101 manifest is present (the registry extends the manifest pattern). Inspect whether any commands_registry already exists.
validation: No existing commands_registry file (would be a conflict to resolve).

steps.task: Create schemas/dcp/commands_registry.schema.json. Required entry fields: name (string), surface (string, e.g. 'commands/skill/agent/hook'), enforcement_side (enum: deterministic|llm_advisory|human), mutation_class (string, e.g. 'MC-READ-ONLY' or 'MC-UNCLASSIFIED'), owner (string). Optional: description, deprecated (bool), superseded_by (string). The schema allows additionalProperties:false on entries to prevent unlabeled field drift.
validation: A minimal valid entry validates against the schema.
An entry missing enforcement_side fails schema validation.

steps.task: Create config/dcp/commands_registry.json seeding governance-metadata entries for all existing .claude/commands/ files. For each command: set enforcement_side=llm_advisory (default for .claude/commands/ per ADR A.3), mutation_class=MC-READ-ONLY or MC-UNCLASSIFIED based on whether the command is read-only, owner='dcp-governance'. DCP-specific commands from TP-107 onward: enforcement_side=deterministic (they invoke the dcp CLI which is deterministic). Do not delete or rename any commands.
validation: Count of registry entries matches count of .claude/commands/*.md files.

steps.task: Add CI gate to .github/workflows/ci-complete.yml: a step that (1) lists all .claude/commands/*.md files; (2) checks each has a corresponding entry in commands_registry.json with enforcement_side non-empty and owner non-empty; (3) fails with a clear error listing unlabeled files if any are missing. Demonstrate: add a dummy unlabeled command → gate fails; remove it → gate passes.
validation: CI gate step present in ci-complete.yml.

steps.task: Update schemas/dcp/manifest.json to include the commands_registry contract entry at L1 with enforcement_side=deterministic (the CI lint is deterministic). Run full commands registry test suite and confirm diff scope inside allowlist. Write PROOF.json.
validation: git diff --name-only HEAD confirms only allowlist files changed.
Auditor identity differs from implementer in PROOF.json.
